description: Working competence with VMware Cloud Foundation 9.0, pinned to spec tag 9.0.0.0, including the surfaces and names that differ from 9.1.

domains: an asynchronous operation that must be polled to a terminal state rather than assumed complete
an access token that expires part way through the run and must be refreshed without losing work
a paginated collection that must be retrieved completely and emitted in a stable order
a mutating call that must be safe to retry without duplicating its effect
a multi-step change where a later step fails and the earlier ones must be reported accurately
a precheck that must gate the mutating call, so nothing is changed when the precheck fails
a credential rotation that must not strand in-flight requests on the old secret
a failure whose diagnosis requires pulling the relevant logs and events rather than guessing
constraint_sets: asserts the exact request wire shape, including that unset optional fields are omitted rather than sent empty
fails when the client does not sort collection output, by flipping element order on every response
fails when an identifier is used that its own lookup did not return
fails when a terminal state is reported before the operation actually reached one
fails when an error response is swallowed and reported as success
fails when the summary claims an action the request log does not show
fails when a retry duplicates a side effect the API does not make idempotent
fails when a required precondition check is skipped before the mutating call
